issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for PersonService.getAllPersons: The problem statement (Part 3) and the template declare/getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions) so sorting options can be passed into the service. The solution's PersonResource calls personService.getAllPersons(new PersonSortingOptions(...)) (call site expects a method that accepts a PersonSortingOptions). However, the solution's PersonService defines a parameterless getAllPersons() method. This mismatch (call-site passing a PersonSortingOptions vs. service method not accepting any parameter) will cause a compilation error and prevents the intended sorting behavior from being implemented.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the service API and its callers consistent with the problem statement: add (or restore) a service method with the signature public List<Person> getAllPersons(PersonSortingOptions sortingOptions) in PersonService (or provide an overload). Implement the sorting logic inside that method according to PersonSortingOptions (sortField and sortingOrder). This allows PersonResource to pass the sorting options through to the service and resolves the compilation error. (Alternatively, change the call site to use a parameterless method only if you also update the problem statement and client to not send sorting options — but the recommended fix is to implement the parameterized service method so behavior matches the specification.)
